maya: Quick heads-up: planning to unpin runtime v2.15 in staging (quant-canary-mini) tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Purpose: validate new kernel heuristics with redwood-llama3q-quant-v2. SDK 4.2.0 required. Any objections?

deploybot: Current snapshot: runtime:v2.15 pinned. Planned: `deploybot unpin --runtime v2.15 --cohort quant-canary-mini --at 2026-03-27T03:00Z`. Auto-pin rule: gw.sdk.header_errors > 50 && err_rate > 0.3% -> `deploybot pin --runtime v2.15`.

leo: Infra note: enable `kvcache-warmup=true` for 30m prior. Fallback: route >16k token requests to runtime:v2.14 compat shim.

sara: QA will run warmup + smoke: `/ci/canary-warmup` then checks: p95 delta <30%, kv_hit >92%, err_rate <0.5%. Preflight logs: warmup OK kv_hit 94%, p95 170ms, err_rate 0.09%.

maya: DevRel confirms Node/Go on SDK 4.2.0. Python wheel planned for 01:30 UTC. If we see 422s from older clients we'll pin back and route to hosted runtimes.

opsbot: @oncall assigned leo for 03:00-04:00 UTC. PagerDuty escalation at 03:10 if auto-pin triggers.

leo: I'll monitor p95/kv_hit/header_errors. If header mismatch spikes or kvcache misses >10% -> pin and notify.

maya: Release note bullets: - Unpin runtime v2.15 in quant-canary-mini - SDK 4.2.0 required (adds X-RW-Kernel header) - Fallback to runtime:v2.14 for >16k tokens - Rollback: `deploybot pin --runtime v2.15` + `routectl set --cohort quant-canary-mini --to runtime:v2.15`

sara: All set from QA. Proceeding with unpin at 03:00 unless anyone objects.

maya: Thanks. Will post final confirmation when ran.
